```{r, warning=F, message=F}


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

source("../../00-constants.R")






# 7.1. Import data


rna_res <- read.csv(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "DE_limma_results_transcriptome.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

prot_res <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "DA_results_proteomics.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)






# 7.2. Merge IDs


rna_df <- rna_res %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_symbol,
    log2FC_RNA = log2FoldChange,
    padj_RNA = padj
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(gene_symbol),
    gene_symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    gene_symbol,
    .keep_all=T
  )


prot_df <- prot_res %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_symbol = gene,
    log2FC_protein = log2FoldChange,
    padj_protein = padj
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(gene_symbol),
    gene_symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    gene_symbol,
    .keep_all=T
  )


merged_df <- inner_join(
  rna_df,
  prot_df,
  by="gene_symbol"
)


merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    sig_class = case_when(
      padj_RNA < 0.05 & padj_protein < 0.05 ~ "RNA & Protein",
      padj_RNA < 0.05 ~ "RNA only",
      padj_protein < 0.05 ~ "Protein only",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ),
    point_size = case_when(
      sig_class == "RNA & Protein" ~ 3.0,
      sig_class == "RNA only" ~ 1.8,
      sig_class == "Protein only" ~ 1.8,
      TRUE ~ 0.7
    )
  )


merged_df$sig_class <- factor(
  merged_df$sig_class,
  levels=c(
    "RNA only",
    "Protein only",
    "RNA & Protein",
    "Not Significant"
  )
)






# 7.3. Correlation values


cor_spearman <- cor(
  merged_df$log2FC_RNA,
  merged_df$log2FC_protein,
  method="spearman"
)

cor_spearman_both <- merged_df %>%
  filter(sig_class == "RNA & Protein") %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(
      log2FC_RNA,
      log2FC_protein,
      method="spearman"
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(correlation)






# 7.4. Prepare plot content


label_df <- merged_df %>%
  filter(sig_class == "RNA & Protein") %>%
  mutate(
    concordance = abs(log2FC_RNA) + abs(log2FC_protein),
    quadrant = case_when(
      log2FC_RNA > 0 & log2FC_protein > 0 ~ "URQ",
      log2FC_RNA < 0 & log2FC_protein < 0 ~ "RLQ",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(quadrant) %>%
  slice_max(
    concordance,
    n=4
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  bind_rows(
    merged_df %>%
      filter(sig_class == "RNA & Protein") %>%
      mutate(
        combined_fc = abs(log2FC_RNA) + abs(log2FC_protein)
      ) %>%
      slice_max(
        combined_fc,
        n=12
      )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    gene_symbol,
    .keep_all=T
  )






# 7.5. RNA vs. Protein concordance plot


concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  merged_df,
  aes(
    x=log2FC_RNA,
    y=log2FC_protein,
    color=sig_class
    )
  ) +

  # Non-significant analytes
  geom_point(
    data=merged_df %>%
      filter(sig_class == "Not Significant"),
    aes(size=point_size),
    alpha=0.18
  ) +

  # Significant analytes
  geom_point(
    data=merged_df %>%
      filter(sig_class != "Not Significant"),
    aes(size=point_size),
    alpha=0.90
  ) +

  scale_size_identity() +

  # Label selected genes significant in both datasets
  geom_text_repel(
    data=label_df,
    aes(label=gene_symbol),
    size=14 / 2.845,
    fontface="plain",
    box.padding=0.5,
    point.padding=0.5,
    segment.color="grey60",
    segment.size=0.3,
    max.overlaps=25,
    show.legend=F
  ) +

  # Zero reference lines
  geom_hline(
    yintercept=0,
    linetype="dotted",
    color="grey70",
    linewidth=0.4
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept=0,
    linetype="dotted",
    color="grey70",
    linewidth=0.4
  ) +

  # Significance categories
  scale_color_manual(
    values=c(
      "RNA & Protein" = "purple",
      "RNA only" = gene_color,
      "Protein only" = protein_color,
      "Not Significant" = "grey85"
    ),
    breaks=c(
      "RNA & Protein",
      "RNA only",
      "Protein only"
    )
  ) +

  # Axes
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits=c(-5, 5),
    labels=function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
  ) +

  # Labels and title
  labs(
    x=expression("Transcriptome log"[2] * " fold change"),
    y=expression("Proteome log"[2] * " fold change"),
    title="Concordance of LRTI-associated features",
    color=NULL
  ) +

  # Theme and typography
  theme_classic(
    base_family="Arial"
  ) +

  theme(
    text=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=16,
      face="plain"
    ),
    axis.title=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=16,
      colour="black",
      face="plain"
    ),
    axis.text=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=16,
      colour="black",
      face="plain"
    ),
    axis.line=element_line(
      colour="black",
      linewidth=0.5
    ),
    plot.title=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=16,
      face="plain",
      colour="black",
      hjust=0.5
    ),
    plot.margin=ggplot2::margin(
      10, 15, 10, 10
    ),
    legend.position=c(0.5, 0.06),
    legend.direction="horizontal",
    legend.title=element_blank(),
    legend.text=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=16,
      face="plain"
    ),
    legend.key.size=grid::unit(
      1.2,
      "lines"
    )
  )

# Export to PDF
ggsave(
  file.path(plots_dir, "(3B)_RNA_protein_LFC_concordance.pdf"),
  plot=concordance_plot,
  width=6.5,
  height=6.5,
  device=cairo_pdf,
  bg="white"
)

# Save plot object for patchwork
saveRDS(
  concordance_plot,
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure3B.rds"
  )
)






```
